# Button

A control that commits an action on this screen.

**In Brand expressive.** The one action: sign up.

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-button--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:brand-expressive" title="Button examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-button--docs">Open Button in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-button--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:brand-expressive;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

- **Use it when:** The press does something here: save, submit, delete, open a dialog, go to the next step.
- **Not when:** The press only takes people to another page, or flips a setting that should persist.

Instead:

- [Toggle](./toggle.md): An on or off setting that should persist as state.
- Link: Navigation to another page or section.

## How Brand expressive uses it

<div class="odv-grid two"><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An icon with no label</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Not used: always add a word</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> An icon button with a hover hint</div></div><div class="cap">On phones, hover hints never show; a word says what will happen.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">Keyboard focus</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> button/focus-ring at border-width.focus</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> Removing the outline</div></div><div class="cap">Focus must show on vivid color.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">The action that completes the task</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Button primary, large, one per section</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> Two primaries</div></div><div class="cap">One loud call to action per section.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An alternative or cancel</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Button ghost</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> A second primary</div></div><div class="cap">The alternative must not compete.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">Delete or remove</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Button secondary, then confirm</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> Button primary</div></div><div class="cap">Confirm before destroying data.</div></div><div class="odv-dd"><div class="stage"><div class="odv-eyebrow">An action on one row or item</div><div style="margin-top:6px"><b style="color:var(--color-status-success)">Use</b> Button ghost with a word</div><div><b style="color:var(--color-status-danger)">Not</b> An icon alone</div></div><div class="cap">A word keeps it clear.</div></div></div>

## Why it works this way

Button looks the way it does because of 8 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Button, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-outcomes-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>Which outcome matters most?</b><code>outcomes.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Engagement</div><p>Engagement and sign-ups.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Button</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>primary</b>: One loud call to action per section.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>large</b>: The one loud call to action per section.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Badge: warning</code> <code>Toast: success</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Button decisions would reopen</small><p>and 6 answers that follow from it: <b>A few minutes</b>, <b>Brand moments</b>, <b>Hero and launch moments</b>, and 3 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-outcomes-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is a costly mistake?</b><code>outcomes.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Looking off-brand</div><p>A bland page is the costly mistake.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Button</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>secondary</b>: The first step of a delete, before the confirm.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Button decision would reopen</small><p>and 1 answer that follow from it: <b>One per moment</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-color-count"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How many emphasis levels do actions need?</b><code>color.count</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Three</div><p>Primary, secondary, ghost.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Button</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>ghost</b>: The alternative next to the primary, and row actions with a word.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Button decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Moving through the page or a dialog. | Tab lands on the button in a logical order. | The control is skipped because it used HTML disabled. |
| The button is focused and the person confirms. | Enter runs the same action as a click. | Enter only works on submit buttons. |
| The button is focused. | Space runs the same action as a click. | Space scrolls the page instead. |
| The button opened a dialog, menu or popover that just closed. | After the action closes a surface, focus returns to the button. | Focus dropped on the page body. |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] The control has a name assistive tech can speak. Any button, especially an icon-only one.
- [ ] The focused control stays visible; color alone is not the cue. Keyboard or assistive-tech focus is on the button.
- [ ] Unavailable stays in the tab order and explains why. The action must not run, but focus must not jump away.
- [ ] A button that stays down exposes its pressed state. Pin, follow, or another sticky on or off on a button.
- [ ] A button that opens something exposes open or closed. The press reveals a menu, panel or more content.
- [ ] The hit area stays usable, including at a small size. Touch, pointer, or a compact toolbar button.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add button
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-` and the base `@` dropped. Each key points to a token; values live only on primitives.

| Key | What it controls | Points to, light | Points to, dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `button/primary/background/@` | Primary button fill. | `color.action.primary.@` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.action.primary.@` → `color.pink.light.600` | `color.action.primary.@` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.action.primary.@` → `color.pink.dark.700` |
| `button/primary/background/hover` | Primary button fill on hover. | `color.action.primary.hover` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.action.primary.hover` → `color.pink.light.700` | `color.action.primary.hover` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.action.primary.hover` → `color.pink.dark.800` |
| `button/primary/label` | Primary button label color. | `color.text.on-action` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.text.on-action` → `color.taupe.light.0` | `color.text.on-action` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.text.on-action` → `color.taupe.dark.0` |
| `button/secondary/background/@` | Secondary button fill. | `color.action.secondary.@` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.action.secondary.@` → `color.taupe.light.0` | `color.action.secondary.@` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.action.secondary.@` → `color.taupe.dark.50` |
| `button/secondary/background/hover` | Secondary button fill on hover. | `color.action.secondary.hover` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.action.secondary.hover` → `color.taupe.light.100` | `color.action.secondary.hover` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.action.secondary.hover` → `color.taupe.dark.100` |
| `button/secondary/label` | Secondary button label color. | `color.text.primary` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.text.primary` → `color.taupe.light.900` | `color.text.primary` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.text.primary` → `color.taupe.dark.900` |

| `button/ghost/background-hover` | Ghost button fill on hover. | `color.surface.sunken` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.surface.sunken` → `color.taupe.light.100` | `color.surface.sunken` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.surface.sunken` → `color.taupe.dark.100` |
| `button/ghost/label` | Ghost button label color. | `color.text.link` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.text.link` → `color.pink.light.700` | `color.text.link` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.text.link` → `color.pink.dark.700` |
| `button/height` | Button height. | `size.control.default` → `size.52` | same |
